crossRefs.note: On the top of the pillars was lily work: so the work of the pillars was finished.
There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and…

translations.web: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.
translations.bsb: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.
translations.kjv: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
translations.asv: And the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily-work, four cubits.
